CHAPTER V.
Advice from a Caterpillar


The Caterpillar, smoking a hookah, questioned Alice about who she
was. She explained her confusing day of changing sizes, and recited
"You are old, Father William" at the Caterpillar's request, though
the words came out wrong. The Caterpillar told her that one side of
the mushroom would make her grow taller, and the other side shorter,
then crawled away.

Alice broke off two pieces of the mushroom. Nibbling one made her
neck stretch enormously, startling a Pigeon who accused her of being
a serpent come to eat its eggs. By nibbling the other piece, Alice
eventually returned to her usual height, and made her way toward a
small house.
